photo.fileTitle: File:Supreme Court of the Netherlands, large courtroom (cropped).jpg
photo.caption: In 2019, the Supreme Court of the Netherlands confirmed that the government must cut carbon dioxide emissions, as climate change threatens human health.
photo.description: Supreme Court of the Netherlands: synthetic image of the large courtroom.

photo.fileTitle: File:Courtroom European Court of Human Rights 01.JPG
photo.caption: In 2024, the European Court of Human Rights ruled that States must protect the population from the serious adverse effects of climate change on lives, health and well-being.
photo.description: Courtroom of the European Court of Human Rights in Strasbourg
